relationships.evidence_quote: AEA has been shown to inhibit Shaker-related Kv1.2 channels

relationships.subject: Anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: both AEA and 2-AG exhibit a high potency (IC50 ≈ 0.9–2.5 μM) to inhibit human Kv1.5 (hKv1.5) current

relationships.subject: 2-AG
relationships.evidence_quote: IA in isolated mouse midbrain dopaminergic neurons is inhibited by 2-AG

key_findings: Review: endocannabinoids, mainly anandamide, modulate potassium channels (BK, Kv4.3, Kv1.2, Kv1.5) independently of CB1/CB2
Anandamide also acts on other ion channels such as TRPV1 (activation) and T-type CaV (inhibition)
